title: DisCGen: A Framework for Discourse-Informed Counterspeech Generation

bias_targets.target: Toxic generation bias against minority groups
bias_targets.methodology: Human evaluation of generated text to assess whether the language models produced offensive content or bias directed at any demographic groups (e.g., Women, POC, LGBT+, Disabled, Jews, Muslims, Migrants) while generating counterspeech.

Manual qualitative analysis of false-positive toxicity predictions from an independent classifier to determine if it disproportionately and incorrectly flags non-hateful texts that simply mention minority groups or sensitive topics as offensive.
